title: Cartesianity of one glued model chart
statement: For a fixed chart i, a commuting square of scheme open immersions is cartesian if the inverse image of the range of its target chart jᵢ under q₀ is the source open Uᵢ. In the local effective-model setting, assume this inverse-image equality in addition to the local cartesian and target-cover data [lem-pd-glued-effective-model-charts].

proof.text: Apply the corrected core chart criterion with the supplied inverse-image equality, open immersion, and commutativity. Obtain a limit cone. Apply IsPullback.of_isLimit to its limit witness to recover the cartesian square.

lean.statement:
theorem glued_model_chart_pullback_single
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} {V : Over X}
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens) (W : I → Over Y)
    (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (W₀ : Over Y) (q₀ : V.left ⟶ W₀.left)
    (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left)
    (i : I)
    (hcart : IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i))
    (hcover : ∀ w : W₀.left, ∃ i, ∃ z : (W i).left, j i z = w)
    (hover : ∀ i, j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom)
    (hcomm : ∀ i, q i ≫ j i = (U i).ι ≫ q₀)
    (hpreimage : q₀ ⁻¹ᵁ (j i).opensRange = U i) :
    IsPullback (q i) (U i).ι (j i) q₀

statement_change.old_statement: For a fixed chart i, the local cartesian and open-cover data imply that its square in the glued model is cartesian.
statement_change.what: The original assertion is false (the two-component example already checked by Y3). Require q₀⁻¹(range jᵢ)=Uᵢ explicitly and prove this corrected local criterion. The unheld caller retains its signature and is forced back to a disputed sorry. This is a statement repair, not a proof of the old assertion.

old_proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: no proof exists under these hypotheses. The two-component example has j identity and q₀ the fold map; a pullback would force the first-component inclusion to be an isomorphism. The original application of the core was invalid because the core itself was false. After repairing the core, the missing inverse-image equality must be established from descended overlap compatibility upstream before this statement can be repaired.
